nphi.title: CAPTURA – Capturing data on AMR patterns and trends in use in regions of Asia
nphi.with: CAPTURA consortium; Fleming Fund (UK aid); national AMR surveillance sites
nphi.summary: Fleming Fund regional grant, run from IVI's platform since 2019, that gathers historical AMR and antimicrobial-use data and trains national teams on prescribing surveys, WHONET analysis and surveillance monitoring.

nphi.title: UK Public Health Rapid Support Team (UK-PHRST)
nphi.with: Deployments bilaterally and through WHO GOARN; academic partners LSHTM, Oxford, King's College London
nphi.type: Outbreak response & research partnership (case study article)
nphi.summary: A PHE–academic team that deploys within 48 hours to outbreaks in low- and middle-income countries and also does research and capacity building. Deployments included cholera in Ethiopia, the 2017 Freetown mudslides, plague in Madagascar,…

nphi.title: IANPHI Asia Regional Network
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Mongolia (vice chair); IEDCR Bangladesh; School of Public Health and Community Medicine Nepal; National Institute of Public Health Japan; National Centre for Disease Control India; National Health Laboratory Myanmar
nphi.summary: Regional network of Asian NPHIs launched in 2016 with China CDC as chair and eight founding members, modelled on the IANPHI Africa network to foster cooperation among Asian institutes; it now counts 28 NPHIs.

nphi.title: CDC–IEDCR partnership in Bangladesh
nphi.with: Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR); icddr,b
nphi.summary: CDC has partnered with IEDCR since the 2001 Nipah outbreak on outbreak response, influenza and priority-pathogen surveillance, FETP, lab and genomic capacity, and the national public health EOC.

nphi.title: EMPHNET FETP exchange: Pakistan residents hosted at IEDCR Bangladesh
nphi.actor: Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR)
nphi.summary: Two FETP Pakistan residents spent two weeks at IEDCR in Dhaka (scientific writing, surveillance site visits, emergency operations simulation, DHIS2/QGIS/R/PHEOC training) with Bangladeshi fellows and mentors.

nphi.title: IANPHI 2025 annual meeting session on climate change and disease
nphi.with: Fiocruz; Santé publique France; Gesundheit Österreich (GÖG); IEDCR Bangladesh; Public Health Agency of Sweden
nphi.summary: Session where Fiocruz, Santé publique France (chair of the IANPHI Climate Thematic Committee), Austria's GÖG and Bangladesh's IEDCR shared COP29/30, heat-health monitoring and flood experiences.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Fellowships phase 2 – Bangladesh and Sri Lanka (host institution CUHK)
nphi.actor: Chinese University of Hong Kong (Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care)
nphi.with: Fleming Fund (UK DHSC); Mott MacDonald; government and research laboratories in Bangladesh and Sri Lanka
nphi.summary: CUHK hosts phase 2 Fleming Fellowships (2024–2025) that mentor fellows from public health, disease control and laboratory institutions in Bangladesh and Sri Lanka on One Health AMR surveillance.

nphi.title: TIP Bangladesh – Vaccination barriers among Rohingya refugees
nphi.with: WHO Emergency Sub-office Cox's Bazar; WHO Country Office Bangladesh
nphi.summary: Studied barriers and drivers to childhood and COVID-19 vaccination among Rohingya in Cox's Bazar.

nphi.title: TuNDRA & TuNDRA PLUS – Real-time tracking of neglected bacterial diseases and resistance in Asia
nphi.with: Child Health Research Foundation; Kumudini Hospital Mirzapur (Bangladesh); COMRU, Angkor Hospital for Children (Cambodia); OUCRU (Vietnam); Wellcome Sanger Institute; Big Data Institute (UK); International Vaccine Institute (South Korea)
nphi.summary: Hospital-based genomic surveillance of bacterial infections and AMR in South/Southeast Asia, later with RSV.

nphi.title: International Emerging Infections Program (IEIP) sites
nphi.with: icddr,b (Bangladesh); Egyptian MoHP and NAMRU-3; GDD Regional Centre partners in China, Guatemala, Kenya and Thailand
nphi.summary: CDC's International Emerging Infections Program ran population-based surveillance and research on emerging infections at six sites, mostly within the GDD Regional Centers, with a Bangladesh site formalised with icddr,b in 2009.

nphi.title: Global Disease Detection (GDD) Regional Centers network
nphi.with: Host ministries of health / national public health institutes (not named on source page)
nphi.summary: CDC set up ten GDD Regional Centers between 2004 and 2013, working with host governments on outbreak detection and response, laboratory capacity, field epidemiology training and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: Regional Field Epidemiology Training Programme for South-East Asia at NCDC India
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.summary: NCDC, a WHO collaborating centre for epidemiology and training, runs a regional field epidemiology course for health staff from WHO South-East Asia Region countries.

nphi.title: Strengthening of IEDCR project (ODA/DFID)
nphi.actor: Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR)
nphi.summary: UK-funded project from 1991 to 1996 to strengthen Bangladesh's national epidemiology and disease control institute; the support ended early when the donor reorganised.
